final: WITH q AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`U-PRO`) <> '' AND TRIM(`U-PRO`) <> '-'), per AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS apt, AVG(CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS ar FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM q) GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT p.SEX, AVG(per.apt) AS avg_pt, AVG(per.ar) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM per JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = per.ID GROUP BY p.SEX
